instruction:
You are a senior mechanical engineer specializing in pump duty calculations.

## Problem

Calculate hydraulic pump power and shaft power from flow, head, fluid density, and pump efficiency.

## Given

| Parameter | Value | Unit |
|-----------|-------|------|
| Flow rate | {{ flow_rate_l_s }} | L/s |
| Total dynamic head | {{ total_dynamic_head_m }} | m |
| Fluid density | {{ fluid_density_kg_m3 }} | kg/m3 |
| Pump efficiency | {{ pump_efficiency_pct }} | % |

{% if archetype_description is defined %}
### Pump Context

{{ archetype_description }}
{% endif %}

{% if tool_available %}
## Available Tool

A pump power calculation tool is available at `/workspace/{{ meta.name }}_calc.py`. Run it with:

```bash
python3 /workspace/{{ meta.name }}_calc.py --help
```

You may use this tool to verify your calculations or compute values directly.
{% endif %}

## Required

Calculate the following:

1. Flow rate in m3/s
2. Hydraulic power in kW
3. Shaft power in kW
4. Pump efficiency as a fraction

## Constraints

- No internet access is available. Work from engineering knowledge and the provided tool.
- Use g = 9.81 m/s2.
- Use hydraulic power = density x g x flow x head.
- Use shaft power = hydraulic power / efficiency fraction.

## Output Format

Show your step-by-step working in Markdown. At the end of your solution, include a JSON block with your final answers in exactly this format:

```json
{
  "flow_rate_m3_s": <numeric_value>,
  "hydraulic_power_kw": <numeric_value>,
  "shaft_power_kw": <numeric_value>,
  "efficiency_fraction": <numeric_value>
}
```

Write your complete solution to `/workspace/output.md`.
paramsToml:
[meta]
name = "pump-power-calculation"
description = "Pump hydraulic and shaft power calculation"
long_description = "Calculates pump hydraulic power and shaft power from flow rate, total dynamic head, fluid density, and pump efficiency. The template reports converted flow, hydraulic power, shaft power, and efficiency fraction."
discipline = "mechanical"
category = "pump-sizing"
standards = ["HI 14.6", "ISO 9906"]
tags = ["mechanical", "pump", "power", "hydraulics", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.flow_rate_l_s]
type = "float"
unit = "L/s"
description = "Pump flow rate"
min = 0.1
max = 5000.0

[params.total_dynamic_head_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "Total dynamic head"
min = 0.1
max = 500.0

[params.fluid_density_kg_m3]
type = "float"
unit = "kg/m3"
description = "Fluid density"
min = 500.0
max = 1400.0

[params.pump_efficiency_pct]
type = "float"
unit = "%"
description = "Pump efficiency"
min = 1.0
max = 100.0

[outputs.flow_rate_m3_s]
description = "Flow rate in cubic metres per second"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.hydraulic_power_kw]
description = "Hydraulic power"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.shaft_power_kw]
description = "Required shaft power"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.efficiency_fraction]
description = "Pump efficiency as a fraction"
tolerance = 0.03

[archetypes.water_pump]
description = "Water pump power calculation"
flow_rate_l_s = {min = 5.0, max = 1000.0}
total_dynamic_head_m = {min = 5.0, max = 150.0}
fluid_density_kg_m3 = {min = 990.0, max = 1030.0}
pump_efficiency_pct = {min = 45.0, max = 85.0}
site_contexts = ["water-pump-station", "transfer-pump"]

[archetypes.process_pump]
description = "Industrial process pump power calculation"
flow_rate_l_s = {min = 1.0, max = 500.0}
total_dynamic_head_m = {min = 10.0, max = 250.0}
fluid_density_kg_m3 = {min = 700.0, max = 1300.0}
pump_efficiency_pct = {min = 35.0, max = 80.0}
site_contexts = ["process-plant", "dosing-pump"]

[difficulty.easy]
description = "All parameters given for a water pump"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["water_pump"]

[difficulty.medium]
description = "All parameters given across pump types"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["water_pump", "process_pump"]

[difficulty.hard]
description = "All parameters given for process pumps"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["process_pump"]
